heads: Dhoni retires from the IPL, becomes CSK mentor
India beat Pakistan for a record 10th SAFF title
Quad unveils maritime watch; GRAP-III lifted in Delhi

paras.t: Namaskar, and welcome to Pringital News. Credible like print, fast like digital. This is your four-minute bulletin for Wednesday, the eighteenth of November, twenty twenty-six, from New Delhi.

First, the headlines. M.S. Dhoni has retired from the Indian Premier League. India have beaten Pakistan to win a record tenth South Asian football championship. And the Quad has announced a new maritime surveillance partnership.

M.S. Dhoni has ended his I.P.L. career after two hundred and seventy-eight matches, five thousand, four hundred and thirty-nine runs and five titles with Chennai Super Kings. The team has named him its mentor from next season. He said goodbye with a reel set to Main Har Ik Pal Ka Shayar Hoon, the song he used when he left international cricket in twenty twenty.

In Dhaka, India came from a goal down to beat Pakistan two–one and win the SAFF Championship for a record tenth time, and the third in a row. Sandip Mandi scored the winner two minutes from time. Pakistan’s players and coach then formed a guard of honour for the champions.

In Manila, the leaders of India, the United States, Japan and Australia announced an Indo-Pacific maritime surveillance partnership and an A.I. Accelerator. The first Quad patrol-aircraft exercise and a Quad business forum will follow in twenty twenty-seven.

India has condemned a missile attack on the L.P.G. tanker Tara Gas in the Strait of Hormuz, which had twenty-four Indian sailors on board. Twenty-one have been brought ashore in Oman; one remains missing.

Cyclone Akvan is expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast near Nellore and Tuni on Friday, with winds of up to one hundred and thirty kilometres an hour. Heavy rain is forecast across the south and east until the twenty-first.

Stage three pollution curbs have been lifted across Delhi and the N.C.R., and schools have resumed physical classes. The air quality index was two hundred and fourteen, in the poor band, on Wednesday morning.

The Sensex fell five hundred and two points to eighty-two thousand and thirty, and the Nifty closed at twenty-five thousand, two hundred and twenty, as jewellery and metal stocks fell. India’s electronics exports rose forty-four per cent to thirty-two billion dollars in the first half of the year.
The Board of Peace has warned the U.N. that the Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse. And U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Iran poses no imminent threat to the United States.

Prince William visited Karan Johar’s Dharma office in Mumbai, where Kareena Kapoor and Saif Ali Khan welcomed him. Panchayat season five streams from the third of December. And Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond.

That was your Pringital News bulletin, the day’s important news in four minutes. For the full story, tap the link on your Pringital page. Read it on your phone, share it on WhatsApp, and help save the trees cut for newsprint. Thank you for listening. Namaskar.
